description:
Plan a stargazing session for the peak of the Geminids meteor shower in Tucson, Arizona. Using Firefox, find specific astronomical data for the night of December 13, 2024. 

1. Go to astronomy data sites (e.g., TimeAndDate.com, Heavens-Above.com, In-The-Sky.org).
2. Set location to Tucson, Arizona and date to December 13, 2024.
3. Find and record the following (in local time):
   - Sunset time
   - Astronomical Twilight End time (when sky is fully dark)
   - Moon Phase (illumination percentage)
   - Moon Set time
   - Jupiter Rise time
   - Geminids Meteor Shower ZHR (Zenith Hourly Rate)
4. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Astronomy Tools' and add at least 2 bookmarks to the tools/pages you used.
5. Save the data to '~/Documents/stargazing_plan.json' with keys: 'location', 'date', 'sunset', 'astronomical_twilight_end', 'moon_illumination_percent', 'moon_set_time', 'jupiter_rise_time', 'geminids_zhr'.
